items.item_text: Maintaining the confidentiality of OPHD matters;
Providing timely communications to parties, reporters, and campus partners;
Conducting trauma-informed and culturally competent intakes, determining next steps, identifying issues that need immediate attention, and providing the Director with recommendations on next steps;
Identifying resources, and interim and supportive measures;
Drafting and monitoring alternative resolution agreements;
Conducting prompt, thorough, impartial, and legally sound investigations;
Interviewing complainants, reporters, respondents, witnesses, and third parties, identifying and gathering evidence and additional information;
Drafting timely, concise, well-written, and thoroughly analyzed investigation reports; and
Maintaining accurate, timely, and complete records of assigned cases in CaseIQ (case management system).
